script_text: Pisces, the veil is thin and Neptune is shouting your name right now. Your ruling planet Neptune is forming a tense square to Mars in your 10th House of Career and Public Standing, creating friction between your spiritual water element and worldly ambition. At the same time, Venus is sextile your natal Sun in your 1st House of Self, gently softening your emotional boundaries. In love, if you are partnered, watch for power struggles over shared finances in your 8th House of Intimacy; if single, magnetic energy draws a stable earth sign through your 4th House of Home and Family. Mars in your 10th House pushes you to lead, but Neptune's square warns against signing contracts or trusting vague promises from superiors today. Avoid aggressive confrontations with authority figures or escaping into fantasy when reality calls. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
